Gua Batu is located in Bukit Batu, a single conical karst hill shaped like an inverted bowl. Bukit Batu stands together with two similar nearby hills arranged in a pattern resembling a cooking stone tripod (tungku). Local communities call it Bukit Tanggar Tungku (Fajari et al., 2018). Based on surface finds, Gua Batu is indicated as a prehistoric habitation cave.
